name: Frozen
description:
A {{gele}} creature is locked in ice. It is {{immobilise}}, it fails every {{dexterite}} {{jet}}, and {{jet|Rolls}} that target it gain 1 {{avantage}}.

At the end of each of its turns, it makes a {{force}} + {{athletisme}} {{jet}} against the {{dd}} of the Skill that {{gele|froze}} it. On a success, the ice gives way and the state ends.
